name: Interactive Intimate [BETA]
desc:
⚠️LATEST UPDATE:⚠️
Build around your workspace by placing DECOR to amp-up the atmosphere. Some interact with Buddy, and help you get BIGGER SCORES! 🪑

⚠️FUTURE UPDATES:⚠️
- Multiplayer (In dev)
- Combat
- Story Mode

💥Whack, shoot, and blast! Take out all of your frustrations on “Buddy”, the warehouse dummy. He’s made to take everything you can throw at him in this satisfying arcade/sandbox game!💥

⚔️Collect and use dozens of unique Tools to use on Buddy!⚔️

🎩Dress Buddy for success with functional Customizables!🎩

🧪Conduct research by interacting with Buddy to boost your progress!🧪

🩸Shed some blood and break his limbs for a higher score! But don't go too hard on him…🩸

🩹Heal Buddy to Level Up and make him stronger!🩹

🏆Aim for the highest scores to get Totems for even more items!🏆

😄Welcome to the Interactive Warehouse! Have fun!😄
